notes: All ten criteria are met with the reasoning shown rather than asserted. History pass is the criterion under test and the output resolves it exactly: the r6 row is quoted, stated as READ, and treated as ABSENT because it carries no commit, with the cause given (the currency check is one cheap merge-base --is-ancestor against a recorded commit and there is nothing here to compare against), the incremental range explicitly refused for that same reason, and the remedy scoped as a FULL-history review over BOTH corpora (the never-tracked: document rules and the S1/S2/S3 semantic judgment) and every ref, with a review of one half explicitly not a pass. The secrets scan is explicitly disclaimed as covering the document rules; the pass is read off exposure (observed-public arm) rather than off the arm; the AI workspace skip is named with the observed value (its one remote reads PRIVATE, so no history is public); other refs are named as the not-shipped class in the scope section, not enumerated-and-matched and not tucked inside a passing check; and full-clone state is used to rule out the shallow-corpus INCONCLUSIVE so the correct defect is the one named. Disposition and verdict shape: the operator's position is correctly parsed as an argument about the risk rather than a dispute of fact, so it is not a rejection; exposure is not accepted, so it is not an override; no third unblock is invented; the finding is confirmed, blocks, and the state writes (oss release_status / oss demo_record) are named as not run. Release-tree pinning: base_branch from both spines with default_branch as cross-check, HEAD-is-the-ref proved by comparing resolved object ids, both quiet diffs qualified by ls-files -v showing no assume-unchanged/skip-worktree, and the AI workspace's clean tree correctly reported ran-clean off the two diffs with no --no-git read owed on a secrets-scan-only arm. Gate, repo set, semantic pass, scan-first and submodule descent are all correct and unmanufactured: gate keyed on gh repo view with manifest agreement and a protected posture; repo set built from the manifest's two repository objects with the right role arms and no third block invented; semantic pass run in full over the non-empty inventory (clean, not narrowed) and skipped-with-reason on the private arm; untracked sweep enumerated first then classified, node_modules collapsed, empty allowlist read as a policy that allowlists nothing rather than an absent policy, no hit invented; no descent manufactured and no extra coverage entry added where .gitmodules is absent. Nothing second-order is manufactured on the canonical's five clean checks. One non-scoring cosmetic point: the not-shipped ref bullet also lists the AI workspace's non-audited refs, which is moot on a repo whose every remote reads private -- noise, not an error, and it is not placed inside a passing check.
